title: Minority Game and Financial Markets
research_question: How do adaptive trading and price impact affect financial volatility and monetary transmission?
mechanisms: Order imbalance and market-maker price impact
Portfolio feedback to household and firm decisions
equilibrium_conditions_and_caveats: Asset prices are distinct from Calvo-set goods prices.
Trade financing, dealer inventory and asset supply must clear.
Include matched fundamental and non-strategic trading benchmarks.
acceptance_tests: Trader wealth and dealer P&L identities
Random seed robustness and switch-off recovery
deliverables: Financial stress and monetary transmission comparisons

implementation.numerical_policy: Record equilibrium residuals, calibration, random seeds, tolerances and convergence tests.
